signal: Reco raised a $30M Series B in February 2026 (total $85M), scaled 400% in 2025, was named a Leader in the 2025 GigaOm SSPM Radar, and launched AI Agent Governance amid the rise of shadow AI.

email.body1:
Angie, saw Reco close a $30M Series B and launch AI Agent Governance off 400% growth last year.

Growth and a raise together usually mean signals pile up faster than the team can act on them, and the lag between an account going in-market and a rep reaching out is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, followed-up outreach on its own: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Reco off your funding and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Angie, quick follow-up for Reco.

Post-raise, the bottleneck for most RevOps and enablement teams is not data, it is the time between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out. That latency is measurable, and it usually shows up as slipping reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Angie, last bit of proof for Reco.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reco's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B security startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Angie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Reco either way.
